data.name: Av
data.gender_notes: Av is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Av is recorded in name-lists as “Father, ancestor”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Av expresses “Father, ancestor”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Av total 5, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: Av is used in Biblical naming tradition with the meaning “Father, ancestor”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Av is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Father, ancestor” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Av; such symbolism is interpretive.

biblical_reference.note: In Hebrew Bible, God's name is written as אֶהֶיְךָ אֶלֹהים אֶחָד  (YHWH), which is often transliterated to 'Adonai' or 'Jehovah' in English, and 'Elohim' in Hebrew. However, in the opening verse of Genesis, the name 'Av' (Father) is used to refer to God.
